packages.name: unified_analytics_kit
packages.tagline: One API that sends events to Firebase, Facebook and your own backend.
packages.tagline_bn: Firebase, Facebook ও আপনার নিজের ব্যাকএন্ডে ইভেন্ট পাঠানোর জন্য একটাই API।
packages.summary: A Flutter analytics toolkit that sends events to Firebase, Facebook App Events and your own backend through one API — with a persistent device ID, an offline queue and per-provider user consent.
packages.summary_bn: একটি ফ্লাটার অ্যানালিটিক্স টুলকিট — একই API দিয়ে Firebase, Facebook App Events ও আপনার ব্যাকএন্ডে ইভেন্ট পাঠায়; সঙ্গে স্থায়ী ডিভাইস আইডি, অফলাইন কিউ ও ব্যবহারকারীর সম্মতি।
packages.features:
One API, many destinations | logEvent reaches Firebase, Facebook and your own backend.
 Consent first | Denied by default and tracked per provider.
 Persistent device ID | Survives reinstall where the OS allows it.
 Offline queue | Hive-backed batching, retry, backoff and Retry-After support.
 Fault isolated | One failing provider never affects the others.
 Validated events | Names and parameters follow Firebase and Facebook rules.
packages.features_bn:
একটি API, একাধিক গন্তব্য | logEvent একসঙ্গে Firebase, Facebook ও আপনার ব্যাকএন্ডে যায়।
 আগে সম্মতি | ডিফল্টে বন্ধ, প্রতিটি প্রোভাইডারের জন্য আলাদা।
 স্থায়ী ডিভাইস আইডি | OS অনুমতি দিলে রিইনস্টলের পরও থাকে।
 অফলাইন কিউ | Hive-ভিত্তিক ব্যাচিং, রিট্রাই ও ব্যাকঅফ।

dependencies:
  unified_analytics_kit:
  git:
  url: https://github.com/psbmlabs/unified_analytics_kit.git
  ref: v1.0.1

projects.title: Barisal Health Connect case study.
projects.summary: Barisal Health Connect gives small clinics a web-based booking and patient-record system: patients book a slot online or the front desk books on their behalf, a.
projects.problem: Small clinics were booking appointments over phone calls and a physical appointment book, which led to double-bookings, no-shows with no reminder system, and patient records scattered across paper files with no easy way to pull up history during a visit.
projects.solution: Barisal Health Connect gives small clinics a web-based booking and patient-record system: patients book a slot online or the front desk books on their behalf, an SMS confirmation goes out automatically, and doctors can pull up a patient's visit history in seconds instead of digging through paper files.
projects.features:
Online appointment booking with automatic SMS confirmation
Front-desk queue view showing today's bookings in order
Searchable patient records with visit history
Role-based access separating front-desk, doctor, and admin views
projects.result: The platform is in active development with a small healthcare provider as the first rollout partner; the architecture is built to extend to multiple clinic locations from a single admin account once the first deployment is validated.

projects.title: EduPortal case study.
projects.summary: EduPortal is a role-based web platform where teachers mark attendance and enter results directly, admins get institution-wide reporting, and parents receive aut.
projects.problem: A local educational institution was managing attendance and results on paper and in disconnected spreadsheets, which made term-end reporting slow and gave parents no visibility into their child's attendance or performance between report cards.
projects.solution: EduPortal is a role-based web platform where teachers mark attendance and enter results directly, admins get institution-wide reporting, and parents receive automatic notifications — replacing a paper-and-spreadsheet process with a single system of record.
projects.features:
Daily attendance marking with automatic absence notifications to parents
Result entry and term-report generation for teachers and admins
Role-based portal separating teacher, admin, and parent-facing views
Staff training and onboarding included as part of the rollout
projects.result: The institution now generates term reports in a fraction of the previous time, and parents get real-time attendance notifications instead of finding out about absences at the next report card. The platform is live and in daily use by staff.

projects.title: FreightTrack BD case study.
projects.summary: FreightTrack BD is a Django dashboard that pulls in location and status data from the fleet and surfaces it as a live operations view: dispatchers can see every.
projects.problem: A regional logistics operator had no central way to see where its fleet was or which shipments were running late — dispatchers relied on phone calls to drivers, and delays were often discovered only after a customer complained.
projects.solution: FreightTrack BD is a Django dashboard that pulls in location and status data from the fleet and surfaces it as a live operations view: dispatchers can see every active shipment's route history, get flagged automatically when a delivery is running behind schedule, and pull delay reports by route or driver.
projects.features:
Live fleet map with per-vehicle route history
Automatic delay flagging based on expected vs. actual arrival
Driver-level and route-level delay reporting for operations review
PostgreSQL backend built to handle historical trip data at scale
projects.result: Dispatchers now catch delays as they happen rather than after a customer calls in, and the delay reporting has given the operator concrete data to identify which routes or time slots consistently run behind. The dashboard is live and in daily operational use.

projects.title: Krishi Bazar case study.
projects.summary: Krishi Bazar is a Flutter marketplace app that lets farmers list produce directly, see live price trends for their crop type, and message interested buyers dire.
projects.problem: Farmers selling produce locally were dependent on middlemen for price discovery and buyer access, which compressed their margins and left them with little visibility into fair market prices in nearby markets.
projects.solution: Krishi Bazar is a Flutter marketplace app that lets farmers list produce directly, see live price trends for their crop type, and message interested buyers directly — cutting out layers of intermediation while keeping the transaction itself simple enough for low-literacy users.
projects.features:
Simple photo-and-price listing flow built for low-bandwidth connections
Price alerts so farmers know when local market rates shift
In-app messaging between farmer and buyer with order status tracking
Node.js/MongoDB backend built to handle seasonal traffic spikes at harvest time
projects.result: The app is live and connects farmers directly with local buyers, giving sellers real-time price visibility they didn't have before and cutting the number of steps between listing a crop and closing a sale.

projects.title: Notun Khata case study.
projects.summary: Notun Khata replaces the paper khata with a Bangla-first Android app: shop owners record credit against a customer's name in seconds, and the app automatically .
projects.problem: Shop owners extending credit to regular customers ('বাকি') were tracking dues in a physical notebook — easy to lose, easy to dispute, and impossible to search when a customer's balance needed checking on the spot.
projects.solution: Notun Khata replaces the paper khata with a Bangla-first Android app: shop owners record credit against a customer's name in seconds, and the app automatically sends an SMS reminder when a balance goes overdue, without the owner having to type anything extra.
projects.features:
Bangla-language interface built for shop owners, not developers
Per-customer running balance with full transaction history
Automatic SMS reminders on overdue dues, configurable by shop owner
Works fully offline using local SQLite storage — no data plan required
projects.result: Shop owners now have a searchable, dispute-proof record of every customer's balance, and the automatic SMS reminders have measurably sped up collection on overdue accounts. The app shipped to the Play Store and is in daily use.

projects.title: Setu POS case study.
projects.summary: We built Setu POS as an Android-first point-of-sale app that works fully offline using a local Room database, then syncs to a central Firebase backend the momen.
projects.problem: Small retail shop owners in and around Barisal were tracking sales and stock by hand in paper registers, which made end-of-day reconciliation slow and error-prone, and gave owners no visibility into stock levels until items had already run out.
projects.solution: We built Setu POS as an Android-first point-of-sale app that works fully offline using a local Room database, then syncs to a central Firebase backend the moment connectivity returns — so a shop with an unreliable internet connection never loses a sale.
projects.features:
Offline-first billing with barcode/manual entry and instant receipt printing
Automatic stock deduction on each sale, with low-stock alerts
Owner dashboard showing daily sales, top items, and stock value across locations
Role-based logins so staff can bill without seeing profit margins
projects.result: Shop owners now close out each day in minutes instead of manually tallying a paper ledger, and stock-outs on fast-moving items dropped noticeably once low-stock alerts were in place. The app is live and in active use across multiple retail locations.

projects.title: Text Studio
projects.summary: A Flutter toolbox of 15 text tools â€” six free and fully offline, nine unlocked with a short ad â€” built on a reusable ads module that keeps the free tier calm.
projects.tech: Flutter, Hive, AES-256, Google AdMob, go_router, Provider
projects.problem: Small text jobs come up all day: counting words before a submission, fixing the case of a pasted paragraph, stripping duplicate lines, making a QR code, translating a sentence, locking a note. Each one usually sends people to a different single-purpose app, and the free ones tend to put an ad in the middle of the task. We wanted one app where simple jobs need no connection, and where ads pay for the app without making people leave.
projects.solution: Text Studio puts every tool one tap from a single home screen. Six core tools are free, work offline and open instantly with no ad gate. The other nine open after a short ad, and the app tells people up front which is which â€” a video icon on the tile, and a clear greyed-out state when there is no internet. A reusable ads module handles consent, ad formats and reloads, so the app itself stays simple.
projects.features:
15 text tools in one app, from Case Converter and Word Counter to Diff Checker, Text to QR/Bar and Text Translate
 Six core tools are free, offline and open instantly; nine are unlocked with a short ad
 AES-256 text encryption that runs on the device
 Hive-based local storage, so saved data never depends on a network
 Featured carousel and a colour-coded 3-column tool grid with light and dark themes
 Tools that need internet grey out with a clear â€œNo internetâ€ label instead of failing after a tap
 Reusable ads module: UMP/GDPR consent, rewarded, rewarded-interstitial and interstitial formats, ad flags from a hosted JSON
 Back button asks before closing the app on Android
projects.result: Text Studio is live with fifteen tools and keeps growing: a new tool is one model entry plus one route, and it inherits the offline and ad behaviour automatically. The ads module built here now also powers the PRO tiles in DailyShield, so the work was reused instead of rebuilt.

projects.title: DailyShield
projects.summary: A Flutter app that gathers daily protection habits into one place: ten tools, five of which count toward a Shield Score that resets every midnight.
projects.tech: Flutter, Hive, Google ML Kit, Google AdMob, go_router, Provider
projects.problem: Looking after yourself and your things is a lot of small, repeating jobs: save the receipt before it fades, change the password that is due, write down what you need to remember, drink water, take the medicine, pray on time, keep the phone quiet where it matters, and know who to call when something goes wrong. People spread these over many apps, and nothing tells them at the end of the day whether they actually covered the basics.
projects.solution: DailyShield brings these jobs into one app built around a single idea, the Shield Score. Five daily tasks â€” scan a receipt, review passwords, write a note, reach your water goal, pray â€” fill a ring pinned to the top of the home screen, and it resets every midnight. Five more tools sit beside them without affecting the score: Auto Silent, Permission Audit, Medicine Reminder, Emergency Contacts and Shield Guard.
projects.features:
Shield Score: an animated ring that fills as the five daily tasks are completed, resetting every midnight
 Score card pinned above the scrolling module grid, with one small icon per daily task
 Tap-through bottom sheet that explains how to earn the score in plain language
 Receipt Scanner: photo crop and compress, on-device text recognition, saved to local storage
 Password Expiry Tracker, Daily Notebook, Water, Medicine and Prayer reminders
 Emergency Contacts hub with emergency numbers for 190+ countries bundled in the app
 Shield Guard: link scan, secure vault, fake call and intruder alert
 Free PRO tools opened by a rewarded ad, with an adaptive banner kept clear of tappable content
projects.result: The core loop is in place: ten modules, a score that stays accurate when modules are switched on or off, offline-capable tools, and an ad setup designed around Play Store policy. DailyShield is in active development, with new modules added through the same module model without touching the home screen layout.

projects.title: PaiNest – The Super App
projects.summary: PaiNest (formerly Paikaree) is a super app that brings shopping, food, grocery, fresh items, beauty and business services into one platform. It has 100K+ downloads on Google Play.
projects.summary_bn: পাইনেস্ট (আগের নাম Paikaree) একটি সুপার অ্যাপ, যা শপিং, খাবার, মুদি, তাজা পণ্য, বিউটি ও বিজনেস সার্ভিস এক প্ল্যাটফর্মে আনে। Google Play-তে ডাউনলোড ১ লাখের বেশি।
projects.role_bn: সিনিয়র সফটওয়্যার ইঞ্জিনিয়ার ও টিম লিড
projects.problem: Customers had to switch between separate apps to shop, order food, buy groceries and fresh items, or book beauty and business services. The company also wanted one brand and one app that could grow beyond a single shopping category.
projects.problem_bn: গ্রাহকদের শপিং, খাবার অর্ডার, মুদি ও তাজা পণ্য কেনা, কিংবা বিউটি ও বিজনেস সার্ভিস বুক করতে আলাদা আলাদা অ্যাপে যেতে হতো। কোম্পানিও চেয়েছিল একটি ব্র্যান্ড ও একটি অ্যাপ, যা শুধু একটি শপিং ক্যাটাগরির বাইরেও বাড়তে পারে।
projects.solution: Paikaree was upgraded and renamed PaiNest, a super app that combines everyday shopping, food, grocery, fresh items, beauty and business services in one place. I led the development team on this official company product and helped carry the app through the rebrand and the expansion to new service categories.
projects.solution_bn: Paikaree-কে আপগ্রেড করে নতুন নাম দেওয়া হয়েছে পাইনেস্ট, একটি সুপার অ্যাপ, যেখানে প্রতিদিনের শপিং, খাবার, মুদি, তাজা পণ্য, বিউটি ও বিজনেস সার্ভিস এক জায়গায়। কোম্পানির এই অফিসিয়াল প্রোডাক্টে আমি ডেভেলপমেন্ট টিমকে নেতৃত্ব দিয়েছি এবং রিব্র্যান্ড ও নতুন সার্ভিস ক্যাটাগরিতে সম্প্রসারণে অ্যাপটিকে এগিয়ে নিতে সাহায্য করেছি।
projects.features:
Shopping, food, grocery and fresh items in one app
 Beauty and business services on the same platform
 Single account and a consistent experience across all categories
 Smooth upgrade path for existing Paikaree users after the rename
projects.features_bn:
একটি অ্যাপেই শপিং, খাবার, মুদি ও তাজা পণ্য
 একই প্ল্যাটফর্মে বিউটি ও বিজনেস সার্ভিস
 সব ক্যাটাগরিতে একটি অ্যাকাউন্ট ও একই রকম অভিজ্ঞতা
 নাম বদলের পর Paikaree-র পুরোনো ব্যবহারকারীদের জন্য সহজ আপগ্রেড
projects.result: Live on Google Play with 100K+ downloads and a 3.9 rating from 385 reviews. Paikaree grew into the PaiNest super app, last updated on 4 Oct 2026.
projects.result_bn: Google Play-তে ১ লাখের বেশি ডাউনলোড এবং ৩৮৫টি রিভিউ থেকে ৩.৯ রেটিংসহ লাইভ। Paikaree থেকে পাইনেস্ট সুপার অ্যাপে রূপ নিয়েছে; সর্বশেষ আপডেট ৪ অক্টোবর ২০২৬।

projects.title: PaiMerchant
projects.summary: PaiMerchant is a merchant app on Google Play that lets sellers run their e-commerce business from a phone: handle orders, track inventory, manage products and stay in touch with customers.
projects.summary_bn: পাইমার্চেন্ট Google Play-তে থাকা একটি মার্চেন্ট অ্যাপ, যা বিক্রেতাদের ফোন থেকেই ই-কমার্স ব্যবসা চালাতে দেয়: অর্ডার সামলানো, ইনভেন্টরি ট্র্যাক, পণ্য ম্যানেজ এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ।
projects.role_bn: সিনিয়র সফটওয়্যার ইঞ্জিনিয়ার ও টিম লিড
projects.problem: Sellers on an e-commerce marketplace need to react quickly: new orders arrive at any hour, stock changes, and customers ask questions. Managing all of that from a desktop panel or by phone calls is slow, and small sellers are rarely at a desk.
projects.problem_bn: ই-কমার্স মার্কেটপ্লেসের বিক্রেতাদের দ্রুত সাড়া দিতে হয়: যেকোনো সময় নতুন অর্ডার আসে, স্টক বদলায়, গ্রাহক প্রশ্ন করেন। ডেস্কটপ প্যানেল বা ফোন কলে এসব সামলানো ধীর, আর ছোট বিক্রেতারা প্রায়ই ডেস্কে থাকেন না।
projects.solution: PaiMerchant puts the seller's whole workflow in a mobile app. Sellers can handle orders, track inventory, manage their products and stay connected with customers from their phone, anytime and anywhere. I led the development team on this official company product, from planning and code review through to releases on Google Play.
projects.solution_bn: পাইমার্চেন্ট বিক্রেতার পুরো কাজের ধারা মোবাইল অ্যাপে এনে দেয়। বিক্রেতারা ফোন থেকেই, যেকোনো সময় ও যেকোনো জায়গা থেকে অর্ডার সামলাতে, ইনভেন্টরি ট্র্যাক করতে, পণ্য ম্যানেজ করতে এবং গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ রাখতে পারেন। কোম্পানির এই অফিসিয়াল প্রোডাক্টে আমি ডেভেলপমেন্ট টিমকে নেতৃত্ব দিয়েছি, পরিকল্পনা ও কোড রিভিউ থেকে শুরু করে Google Play-তে রিলিজ পর্যন্ত।
projects.features:
Order handling: receive and process orders from the phone
 Inventory tracking to keep stock up to date
 Product management: add and edit products
 Customer communication from inside the app
 Mobile-first design for small business owners and growing brands
projects.features_bn:
অর্ডার হ্যান্ডলিং: ফোন থেকেই অর্ডার গ্রহণ ও প্রসেস
 স্টক হালনাগাদ রাখতে ইনভেন্টরি ট্র্যাকিং
 পণ্য ম্যানেজমেন্ট: পণ্য যোগ ও সম্পাদনা
 অ্যাপের ভেতর থেকেই গ্রাহকের সঙ্গে যোগাযোগ
 ছোট ব্যবসায়ী ও ক্রমবর্ধমান ব্র্যান্ডের জন্য মোবাইল-ফার্স্ট ডিজাইন
projects.result: Published on Google Play in the Business category and actively maintained, with the latest update released on 11 Oct 2026.
projects.result_bn: Google Play-তে Business ক্যাটাগরিতে প্রকাশিত এবং নিয়মিত রক্ষণাবেক্ষণ করা হচ্ছে; সর্বশেষ আপডেট ১১ অক্টোবর ২০২৬।
